comment: sumRange on the level jack is written as a voltage spelling because that is the only spelling the field takes; the figure is the gain the sum is clamped to, 0 to 2 times, not a voltage. The duck law is 1 - duckV/10 * duckKnob * 3, floored at zero (src/U8.cpp:412), so at the top of the DUCK knob a duck signal of a third of ten volts already silences the channel. The chain jacks are summed after the channel's own level, duck and mute, so a chained signal is never touched by this module's controls. The solo search walks leftExpander and rightExpander and stops at the first module that is not a U8, an ALEXANDERPLATZ or a SHINJUKU, reading their solo parameters by hardcoded index (src/U8.cpp:316-350). The panel prints U8, INPUT, LEVEL, DUCK and the pair MUTE and SOLO; the chain jacks and the two output jacks carry no lettering. Lettering is drawn in code at src/U8.cpp:619-660.
